item.tib: glegs bam mnga' dbul gyi lag khrigs kun gsal me long
item.coloph: glegs bam gyis (gyi) mnga' dbul lags khrigs 'di ni/ gshen gyi drang srong tshul khrims 'od zer gyis/ lho gter dang sham po ma gnyis kyi gzhung don cha lag ci bzhin legs par sgrigs (bsgrigs) nas sdeb (bsdebs) pa lags so/ sdeb nyes skyabs yul rnams kyi gnyen la bshags/ dge ba 'gro kun sems can don du bsngo//
